title: Bland AI Pricing in 2026: Plans and Cost per Minute
summary: Bland AI pricing charges per minute of connected calls plus a monthly plan. Compare all tiers to calculate your total expenses based on call volume.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Before you rely on any answer below, confirm it against the vendor page it names, and write beside what you find the date you read it.


### Does Bland AI have a free plan?


Treat any free allowance as a test budget, not a rate to model with. Confirm on Bland's pricing page whether a free tier exists, what it caps, and whether it carries the same per-minute rate as paid plans.


If the free rate differs from the paid one, **your test calls will understate production cost** . Record the date you read the page.


### Is Bland AI billed per minute or per call?


Per minute is how the headline rate is quoted, but the question that moves your bill is what happens around it. Check Bland's pricing page and billing terms for rounding rules, per-call minimums and whether unanswered or failed calls are charged.


When a call rings out and still bills, it is a cost with no connected minute behind it, which raises your cost per useful minute. Note the date you checked.


### Does the per-minute price include the voice and the language model?


Don't assume it does until the vendor's pricing page says so line by line. Look for anything itemised separately: telephony, transcription, custom voices, messaging or model usage.


Treat each separate line as an add-on, and add-ons are what turn a clean headline rate into a different effective one.


If the page is vague on any item, that is the line to ask about in writing, not on a call you can't reproduce later.


### Can I cancel Bland AI or change plans mid-month?


Read the terms of service and the billing section of your account before committing, because this answer lives there, not in the marketing copy.


You need to know three things: whether a downgrade takes effect immediately or at renewal, whether unused plan fees are refunded or prorated, and whether a minimum commitment survives cancellation.


If you can't find these in the published terms, treat the plan fee as sunk for the full period when you calculate cost.


### How often does Bland AI change its pricing?


I can point to no published schedule from Bland, so assume the page can change without notice. The practical response is to date every figure in your own spreadsheet and re-read the vendor page before each renewal or volume change.


If a tier can't be understood without a sales call, it also can't be checked on a schedule, which is a cost in itself. Put the check date next to every rate you rely on.
